summary: The MEXT Scholarship: IGP Special Quota is a Japanese Government (MEXT) scholarship quota for Hokkaido University's International Graduate Program in Sapporo, Japan, for October 2027 admission. It is aimed at Master's and PhD applicants in the life sciences and sciences. Applicants first secure the agreement of a supervisor, who then submits the application documents to the IGP office.
highlights: For Master's and PhD applicants in Life Sciences / Science.
Admission is for October 2027 to Hokkaido University's International Graduate Program.
First step: contact a prospective supervisor by 10 November 2026 and secure their agreement.
The supervisor submits documents to the IGP office by 10 December 2026 (JST).
The official page labels these dates as tentative.
